tablet.notes:
New notifications: the conversation so far, with Reply, Copy code and Mark as read buttons. Swiping one away never marks it read.
The round Message+ icon now opens Messages (Mark all as read, Archived, Trash, backup, blocked, muted) and Messages features: Undo send (every chat, group chats only, or chats you pick), I'm busy (texts back after texts or missed calls, people you leave out, and a notification you tap to turn it off) and automatic replies for one person (when they text, when you decline their call, when you miss it).
Pin as many messages as you like (from the fourth a button slides the list down), Remind me, and the Message info pop-up is back.
Calls: the split screen works on a wide screen in every layout (its switch is in the Calls settings), and Calls can be hidden. Settings are regrouped: Layout holds Resize screens and Swipe between screens, and Groups, Calls and Voicemail have their own folder. The tablet can tell the flip phone to stop a sync.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes:
Tapping the Message+ "Connected - listening" notification now opens Message+ (it used to show a pop-up). It no longer opens the "Change SMS app?" screen either.
The restart notes sent to the tablet (Crash log > Home app) now include the battery level from just before the restart, so a restart after a dead battery can be recognized.

messageplus_previous.notes:
Home app update (Home App (Message+) > Update it): it records its own crashes from the very start and notes every restart of the phone.
Message+ now tells the tablet (Crash log > Home app), within 2 minutes, which home screen is the default after a restart or whenever it changes, so "the Home app crashed" and "Android forgot the default" can be told apart.
The tablet can tell the phone to stop a sync (the phone checks every few seconds while it syncs).

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
